I am a visual systems biologist and PhD candidate at the
University of Cincinnati in \[Elke Buschbeck's lab\](https://www.buschbecklab.com/).
I hold an MRes in evolution and biodiversity from University College London,
and a BSc in zoology and biochemistry from the University of Mumbai.

I study animal eyes and lenses in terms of their development and function.
Apart from research, I am a freelance artist, and use my illustrations to
help visualise and communicate science.
